summary: Phase 5 extras tested backend (pytest 28 tests, 26 pass) and frontend (Playwright desktop 1920 + mobile 390). Working: Match hero referee/stadium meta, Events tab (summary 0-2 / 3-0 / 5-4, All/Goals/Cards/Subs filter 14/2/3/9, home left x=504 / away right x=938, goal/card player links go to /player, 'X on for Y' subs, (penalty)/(own goal) flags in API), scheduled match shows events-empty; League Referees tab (34 rows Serie A, correct columns); Leaderboards with all 9 extra stats non-empty; Squad grid 15 stat options, x hides a game and Avg recalculates (2 -> 2.3 -> 2.5), 'Show N hidden' restores, persists per team after reload; Team totals adds xG/Yellow/Red; Finder Likelihood shows only 5 core stats, Form/Run show extras and searches return results (Form interceptions 2+ = 24 rows, Run fouls_won = 100), switching back to Likelihood resets the stat to shots; Player Show table Columns picker saves to localStorage and survives reload, Cards column markers, history-sub 'On 60' for Tiago Gabriel' / 'Off 66', Jamil Siebert on'; Admin Jobs extras card 430 / 430, Waiting 0, '2 extra PitchAPI calls', Queue missing matches -> toast '0 matches queued'; mobile 390 shows no horizontal page overflow on any of the 4 screens. One real bug: Team totals Against column is always empty for Yellow/Red cards.

minor.issue: The 'against' value is always null. team_totals_grid reads r.get(stat + '_against'), but team_match_stats has no yellow_cards_against / red_cards_against (0 of 860 docs). xg_against exists, so xG works. The UI shows '–' in Against for every game.

A second yellow is stored as a red AND a yellow event at the same minute (Lecce v Juventus, Kialonda Gaspar 90+4: red is listed before the yellow). Cards are double-counted: the match summary says Cards 3 when it was 2 yellows that led to a red, team yellow_cards_ev=2 while the stats feed says 1, and referee yellow_pg is inflated. Keep one event and sort yellow before red at the same minute.
Returns 30 rows with only 4 above 0; the other 26 have total 0. Filter out total == 0 for sparse stats (red cards, pen goals).
Disabled leagues return 404 and every enabled league has referees, so the referees-empty state can't be reached with the current data (not tested in UI).

ui_bugs.issue: Against bars always show '–' (caused by the backend gap above)

issues: Substitution names (player in and player out) are plain text, not links. Goal and card names are linked.
The sub icon (red/green circle) looks a lot like the card icons when small.
Yellows a game mixes formats: '5' and '1' next to '3.8' (num1 drops the decimal for whole numbers). Reds and Penalties use toFixed(2). Use one consistent format.
A player with 2 yellows in a game shows only one yellow marker.
The Columns picker (details element) does not close on an outside click and overlays the table.

action_items: Team totals: write yellow_cards_against / red_cards_against into team_match_stats (mirror from the opponent row, as for xg_against), or compute 'against' from the opponent's row in team_totals_grid.

Second yellow: collapse a yellow plus red at the same minute for the same player into a single 'Second yellow (red)' event; fix the order and the counts (match summary, team yellow_cards_ev, referee yellow_pg).
Optional: link substitution player names; use one number format in the referee table.
critical_code_review_comments: queries.team_totals_grid assumes a '<stat>_against' field for every TEAM_STATS entry. Only xg has one among the new stats.

match_extras._apply puts card counts on team_match_stats as yellow_cards_ev, but Team totals reads yellow_cards (stats feed). That's two sources of truth and they disagree (1 vs 2 for Lecce v Juventus).
rebuild_referees runs one find_one per match (N+1). Fine at 430 matches; use one $in query as data grows.
useStored keys 'hide:<teamId>' and 'cols:history' are never pruned. Stale ids are harmless but pile up.
